authentication.ha_auth: Core-issued Bearer, active human administrator; Core refresh/revocation remains authoritative
authentication.legacy: persisted static client credential and signing key; administrator-equivalent single tenant
authentication.native_execution: no internally generated access token required; revalidate principal/owner and authorize explicitly

generated_ids.client_contract: Reuse the returned unique_id/entity_id; generated formats are not interchangeable algorithms.

entity_edit_history.registry_key: Core registry entry UUID (config.id), independent of entity_id renames
entity_edit_history.registry_restore: existing identity only; restore user registry fields and options through Core owners, never synthetic state writes
entity_edit_history.legacy_exposure_restore: state-only entities retain exact Core exposure preferences, including absent preferences versus explicit false; a new registry registration causes a conflict
entity_edit_history.legacy_state_restore: only state and attributes through the actual StateMachine, with a fresh actor Context; may create a temporary state, trigger automations and be replaced by its provider; does not restore a registration or physical device
entity_edit_history.safety_compare: typed before-image captured before awaits; restore must refuse a change after that same safety image
entity_edit_history.missing_registration: explicit unsupported recreation; restoring history does not recreate an integration-owned entity

ha_config_get_dashboard.reason: Describing a custom card or listing card types can initialize the actual Core resource owner and migrate resources on first inspection. include_screenshot requires write admission because the renderer may persist its user's profile. Native argument policy permits ordinary config/list/search reads and subsequent inspection of loaded resources in read-only mode. The original openWorldHint=true and the standalone annotations remain unchanged.

ha_get_dashboard_screenshot.reason: The renderer may persist its user's profile even without explicit theme arguments. Every native render requires write admission, with a final check before each HTTP request; native execution never retries a failed capture and stops queued viewports after uncertainty. Standalone annotations remain unchanged.

ha_config_list_dashboard_resources.reason: The first Core resource-storage read can migrate and persist dashboard/resource data. Native list discovery discloses that effect and requires write admission while the collection is not loaded; subsequent loaded reads and YAML mode remain read-only. The standalone catalog retains its original annotations.

ha_get_integration.reason: Options/subentry schema inspection and password-field redaction initialize actual Core flows, which can mutate immediately. Native argument policy permits persisted metadata/options reads without flows when redaction is disabled. Native parameter descriptions disclose these effects instead of claiming subentry introspection cannot create anything; legacy signatures and metadata remain unchanged.

ha_config_list_helpers.reason: Describing a flow-backed helper can call Core async_init, which may immediately create a config entry. Native discovery must disclose that effect; argument-specific policy still permits storage listing/description in read-only mode. The standalone catalog remains unchanged.

native_trace_diagnostics.trace_storage_enabled: derived from the actual Core owner's _trace_config; null when unavailable
native_trace_diagnostics.legacy_diagnostics: unchanged; these native corrections do not alter tool signatures or safety annotations

native_health_diagnostics.component_count: number of loaded component domains, rather than character count of their serialized list
native_health_diagnostics.system_health_probes: resolve actual Core observations with bounded waiting and owned executor drain; never cancel a shared Core probe Future
native_health_diagnostics.independent_sections: baseline_available=false when Core system_health is absent; independently available sections remain usable
native_health_diagnostics.update_source: omit optional ha_mcp_update without authoritative Core/HACS information; PyPI/Supervisor package versions do not establish custom-component or fork updates
native_health_diagnostics.public_contract: original schemas and safety annotations remain unchanged

native_updates.owner: published UpdateEntity/EntityComponent, original Core update services, and IssueRegistry.async_ignore
native_updates.reads: list/get retain public presentation and add complete provider attributes; provider release notes are read directly and public GitHub enrichment remains best effort
native_updates.classification: actual Supervisor Core/OS/Supervisor entity classes remain protected from category batches even after entity renames
native_updates.self_affecting: Core/OS installs are scheduled and revalidated before a clean-context handoff to Core; remaining batch targets are not dispatched and the reply does not confirm installation completion
native_updates.uncertainty: post-dispatch exceptions, provider cancellation and unverifiable skipped-version readback are outcome_unknown; no replay and no remaining-target dispatch
native_updates.update_source: no PyPI sidecar status is presented as the native HACS component's update authority
native_updates.qualification: unit owners and cold import are exercised; the Container fixture uses real UpdateEntity and Repairs APIs, while actual Supervisor/OS updates are not qualified
native_updates.public_contract: original schemas, coercion and safety annotations remain unchanged; prose discloses native scheduling and optional self-update information

native_pipelines.owner: published Core Assist pipeline collection and conversation manager/agent
native_pipelines.process: text conversation with the selected agent, not a complete STT/TTS run
native_pipelines.locking: release configuration mutex before conversation; retain admission/pins inside the owned worker so an agent can call configuration tools without waiting on its caller's mutex
native_pipelines.visibility: refuse opaque process while hiding rules are enforced; listing and decluttering retain their behavior
native_pipelines.preferred: use the listed Core pipeline ID; the historical preferred literal was never a Core alias
native_pipelines.intent_failure: actions may already have occurred; inspect before repeating
native_pipelines.public_contract: original schemas, coercion and safety annotations remain unchanged

native_themes.owner: actual Core Frontend library/services and engine user's UserStore
native_themes.read: cached loaded store only; never trigger storage initialization or cancel its shared Future
native_themes.write: validate before admitted potentially migrating load; pin user/store/schema, compare typed before-image and drain owned I/O
native_themes.identity: only locally validated effective renderer app token; never substitute caller/server credentials or create a token
native_themes.qualification: Container proves actual theme defaults and absent renderer refusal; real Supervisor/Puppet discovery and engine account are not qualified
native_themes.public_contract: original schemas, coercion and safety annotations remain unchanged

native_system_actions.self_affecting: restart/self-reload are scheduled requests, not completed restart/reload promises
native_system_actions.handoff: revalidate actor, credential, unchanged policy and target, then original Core job with a fresh actor Context and cleared MCP admission context
native_system_actions.shutdown: cancel pending handoffs before draining Engine; handed-off Core work cannot wait on its own manager
native_system_actions.ordinary_reload: await Core result and retain partial/unknown outcomes; no transport polling
native_system_actions.qualification: actual script, config-entry and self reloads; full process restart is not established by this Container bench
native_system_actions.public_contract: original schemas, coercion and safety annotations remain unchanged

native_energy.owner: published Core EnergyManager, installed validator and original source normalizer
native_energy.not_ready: temporary unavailable result for an absent manager or its shared loading Future; never initiate storage load or migration from a read
native_energy.normalization: detached expected and writer payload copies; compare typed Core data after callbacks
native_energy.dispatch: one native save attempt, no rebase or replay after an uncertain outcome
native_energy.post_save_race: withhold config/hash/validation if authority, owner or preferences change during semantic validation; retain write_completed=true, operation_outcome=confirmed and requires_reread=true
native_energy.public_contract: original schemas, coercion and safety annotations remain unchanged

native_bulk_operations.operation_ids: device-* IDs are scoped to the invoking user, client and manager; Engine invocation IDs remain distinct
native_bulk_operations.repeated_target: serialized per target with its own before-image, confirmation and overlap warning
native_bulk_operations.after_effect_failure: partial results and outcome_unknown are preserved; remaining queued targets are not dispatched
native_bulk_operations.dry_run: selector preview is read-only according to arguments
native_bulk_operations.public_contract: original schemas and safety annotations remain unchanged

native_groups.owner: original Core Group, installed service validators and EntityComponent
native_groups.older_snapshot_mode: preserve the current mode, or Core default during recreation, with an explicit warning
native_groups.nullable_icon: restore null through the original Core setter
native_groups.persistence: runtime only; YAML and startup configuration remain authoritative after reload or restart
native_groups.public_contract: original schemas and safety annotations remain unchanged

native_blueprints.restoration: Core Blueprint.yaml() normalizes YAML and may remove comments, as in the legacy path
native_blueprints.external_file_writers: optimistic preflight only; Core has no atomic compare-and-write against simultaneous external edits
native_blueprints.reads: list, get and substitute are classified as reads by arguments
native_blueprints.public_contract: original schemas and safety annotations remain unchanged

native_search.execution: detached full Core candidates; visibility and secret filtering precede matching, scores, totals and pagination in an owned worker
native_search.config_bodies: emit only registered Core config-view reads; loaded YAML stays searchable but its body is withheld even when it has a unique_id
native_search.yaml_dashboards: match through the actual Core owner; emit metadata, never config or body-derived titles
native_search.scrub_unavailable: omit all config search and reference graph results with a partial-result reason
native_search.budgets: config_time_budget scopes automation/script/scene; dashboards retain the HA-scoped individual_config_timeout
native_search.public_contract: original schemas and safety annotations remain unchanged

native_apps.owner: Core HassIO, SupervisorClient and the registered HassIOIngress URL/session owner
native_apps.writes: Every ha_manage_app mode requires write admission, including opaque HTTP GET. Native hidden-entity enforcement refuses this tool; ha_get_app remains a read.
native_apps.transport: Named Supervisor methods and actor-attributed ingress sessions. HTTP borrows Core's session with a per-call no-retry middleware. WebSocket uses the existing library in single-attempt mode and refuses handshake redirects. No Home Assistant connection or transport fallback is introduced.
native_apps.configuration: Supervisor validates options; its model serializes the request. Native does not discard options by treating UI schema fields as authoritative. An optimistic before-image check and an explicit readback result replace claims of atomic update.
native_apps.array_patch: One GET and one POST, serialized among our calls, without a conditional-write guarantee against other app clients. The before-image is detached before shared array edits.
native_apps.qualification: Local real HTTP/WebSocket tests prove single request/command, dropped response and redirect refusal. Core Container proves explicit Supervisor absence; actual HAOS app management remains unqualified.

explicit_exceptions.surface: automatic restore of a missing calendar UID
explicit_exceptions.native_compatibility: Core exposes bounded occurrences, not authoritative UID absence. Restore updates a located occurrence; an unlocated UID returns calendar_identity_unavailable and saved manual creation arguments. No recreation follows an empty query or a failed provider update.
